notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Illuminor Szeras.
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Ebondeath dies, triggering Illuminor Szeras, untapping Illuminor Szeras.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
